future_preconditions: An already authorized compatible runtime is reachable without bypassing current restrictions.
Exact model digest and both immutable request payload hashes verified.
Full task and existing token/context budgets preserved; no truncation to force completion.

clock_policy.clock: monotonic elapsed time plus UTC receipts
clock_policy.dispatch_admission: Before each request, remaining all-stage budget must cover the full 600-second request allowance plus the unspent 480-second scoring/preservation reserve. Preflight, load, transport, generation, collection and scoring all count toward the 1800-second ceiling.
clock_policy.request_timeout_includes: Connection, model loading, first token, entire response and response collection; no fresh timer per transport stage.
clock_policy.on_timeout_or_unknown_outcome: Preserve request/partial response/terminal uncertainty; do not retry or dispatch remaining arm. Local deadline does not prove server cancellation; keep_alive=0 is not a cancellation receipt.
clock_policy.on_identity_or_transport_denial: Preserve evidence and stop remaining dispatch without endpoint, socket, HOME or permission workaround.
clock_policy.incomplete_pair_disposition: INCONCLUSIVE_UNPAIRED; no winner, pooled success rate or quality improvement claim.
clock_policy.expiry: Stop new work at all-stage deadline and preserve the outcome; explicit time spent preserving is still reported even if a cleanup fault overruns the ceiling.

separation: This future paired-inference experiment is not LoRA training. Its 1800-second cap is independently specified and does not authorize, consume or extend the separate unapproved first-LoRA pilot budget.
preservation: Both input packets, exact runtime identity if observed, dispatch times, terminal status, partial outputs, scoring records and actual stage durations.
